value.name: Dinner & Networking with Walmart Health & Wellness
value.description:
Join representatives from Walmart Health & Wellness for an evening of networking, conversation, and dinner at The Highland Pub & Kitchen in Glenside.

This event is an opportunity for PCO students to learn more about career opportunities within Walmart Health & Wellness, connect with practicing optometrists and recruitment professionals, and ask questions about clinical practice, career development, compensation, work-life balance, and professional growth.

Whether you are actively exploring employment opportunities or simply interested in learning more about different practice settings, all interested students are encouraged to attend.

Dinner will be provided courtesy of Walmart Health & Wellness.

Date: Monday, June 22
Time: 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM
Location: Highland Restaurant & Pub, Glenside, PA

Space is limited and is invite-only. Please RSVP in advance if you received an email invitation to attend this event.

value.name: NSF GRFP Workshop 1 - Setting Yourself Up for Success
value.description:
This workshop will provide a brief overview of NSF GRFP application components, then walk you through reflection and planning exercises to help you map out your application process.

This is the first of four biweekly summer workshops on the NSF GRFP; applicants are also encouraged to participate in our grad fellowships biweekly writing group. You can learn more about these events and review materials from previous info sessions and workshops on our NSF Applicant Resource Site (Drexel login required).

The National Science Foundation’s Graduate Research Fellowship Program (GRFP) provides selected fellows with three years of funding, including a living stipend and tuition funds, to support a research-focused doctoral degree in STEM, social sciences, or STEM education. The current application cycle is open to US citizens and permanent residents planning to begin their first graduate program in Fall 2027, or who will be in the 1st year of a PhD program in Fall 2026. BS-MS students planning to continue on to a PhD program are only eligible to apply in their final year of BS-MS study (and not as first year doctoral students).

Register on Zoom to attend

value.name: Pre-Writing Workshop: Graduate Fellowships
value.description:
Applications to graduate fellowships require significant planning, and may differ significantly from other types of writing or applications you have done in the past. This workshop is open to all students and alumni planning to apply for fellowships for graduate study or post-graduate experiences; those currently focused on applications to graduate school may also find it useful. The workshop will cover how to plan the application process, thinking strategically about how you seek other support, reflective exercises for pre-writing, and strategies for organizing your content.

Please note that this is not an information session about specific fellowships. We recommend reviewing our fellowships database (https://drexel.edu/pennoni/urep/fellowships/finding-fellowships/) to identify specific opportunities for which you plan to apply, identify the award selection criteria, and bring that information with you to the workshop, to get the most benefit from our time together.

Register on Zoom to attend
